description: This file implements the Csv class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for reading CSV file formats into a Spreadsheet object. It includes methods for encoding detection, delimiter inference, BOM skipping, and CSV parsing with customizable options like delimiter, enclosure, escape character, and encoding. It also provides features for handling various encoding BOMs, automatic line ending detection, and compatibility with different PHP versions.

classes.name: Csv
classes.description: A class for reading CSV files into PhpSpreadsheet objects, providing options for encoding, delimiter, enclosure, escape character, and BOM handling.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the worksheet(s) in a CSV file, such as number of rows and columns.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads a CSV file into a PhpSpreadsheet object.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromString
methods.description: Loads CSV data from a string into a PhpSpreadsheet object.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the current CSV delimiter character.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the sheet to load.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the sheet to load.

methods.name: setContiguous
methods.description: Sets whether rows are loaded contiguously.

methods.name: getContiguous
methods.description: Returns whether rows are loaded contiguously.

methods.name: setEscapeCharacter
methods.description: Sets the escape character for CSV parsing.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the file can be read as a CSV by this reader.

methods.name: affectedByPhp9
methods.description: Test to determine if the current PHP version affects CSV reading compatibility, comparing output between different escape character settings.
